newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila eyes $250mln worth of business with India.
newsitem.headline: Manila eyes $250mln worth of business with India.

text.p: Philippine President Fidel Ramos said on Wednesday his recent trip to India had paved the way for business deals worth a "conservative" $250 million.

Ramos, returning from a trip to south Asia and the Middle East, said Filipino businessmen accompanying him signed five agreements with their Indian counterparts and began talks on another five proposed deals covering transportation, communications and fruit and vegetable production, he said.

The Philippine delegation also signed a cooperation agreement with Pakistan on peaceful uses of atomic energy and manpower accords with Qatar and Bahrain to improve the welfare of thousands of Filipinos working in those two countries, he said.
He said the message he delivered during his 10-day trip was that the "the Philippines is back for good in business".
No further details were immediately available.
